name: quarter
description: Reference quarter of the observation, from 1 to 4
observations: Empty for financial-year series, which describe a whole year rather than a quarter

name: financial_year
description: Australian financial year of the observation, such as 2025-26
observations: Empty for quarterly series; ABS dates a financial-year series at the June ending that year

name: series_id
description: ABS time series identifier of the series
observations: Stable ABS Series ID (A-code); the series key, unique per combination of dimensions

name: statistic
observations: Harmonised across ABS workbooks: the same statistic is spelled differently between a release's quarterly and financial-year tables

name: series_type
description: ABS series type: Original, Seasonally Adjusted or Trend
observations: Only the Wage Price Index publishes more than Original; ABS records the type in the workbook metadata, never in the series description

name: pay_measure
description: Wage measure priced by the index
observations: Total or ordinary time hourly rates of pay, each excluding or including bonuses

name: region
observations: Australia plus the eight states and territories. Could map to a state geography directory in the future

name: sector
description: Ownership sector of the employing organisation
observations: Private, Public, or Private and Public

name: industry
description: ANZSIC industry division of the employing organisation
observations: The 19 ANZSIC divisions plus All industries

name: frequency
description: Publication frequency of the series: Quarter or Annual
observations: The Wage Price Index is the only release in this dataset publishing both quarterly and financial-year series

name: unit
description: Unit of the reported value, as published by ABS
observations: Units vary within a single ABS table, so the unit is carried per row rather than per table

name: value
description: Value of the series in the reference period, in the unit given by the unit column
observations: Carries no fixed measurement_unit: a tidy-indicator column whose unit varies by row and is given by the unit column
